integrity: The full recent primary source was checked at the lattice construction, its upper and lower growth estimates, Hadamard rigidity, insertion index, and the interior exponential family. The new endpoint and completeness statements are proved directly from those estimates, with no numerical experiment. Earlier Fock zero-set literature was compared for scope.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies exact realizers only for the explicit square-lattice family with one deleted lattice line and finitely many additional deleted points. It does not classify the full vanishing space, other critical lattices, multiple deleted lines, or arbitrary critical configurations.
title: Exact exponential-realizer window for line-deleted critical Fock zero sets
